claims: Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22.
Over 1 billion people participate in Earth Day globally.
Earth Day was founded in 1970 by Senator Gaylord Nelson.
The first Earth Day was held on April 22, 1970, in the United States.
The first Earth Day followed a massive oil spill in Santa Barbara, California.
The first Earth Day mobilized 20 million people.
The first Earth Day led to the creation of the EPA.
More than 192 countries participate in Earth Day events.
Earth Day 2026 campaigns focus on cleaning up millions of pounds of waste.
Earth Day 2026 campaigns focus on investing in global reforestation through projects like The Canopy Project.
The Earth Day Initiative hosts virtual and in-person events for Earth Day 2026
